name: Genesis
title: Genesis — Beginnings
tagline: Creation, fall, promise, and the seed line that runs to Christ.

author.traditional: Traditional: Moses. Critical notes vary; the book presents unified Torah foundation.

date.range_display: Setting: creation → Joseph in Egypt. Composition: Mosaic era (traditional c. 15th/13th cent. BC depending on Exodus dating).

audience: Israel leaving Egypt / entering covenant identity — and the church reading origins.
purpose: Reveal who God is, who we are, why the world is broken, and the first gospel promise.
christ: The promised Seed (3:15); Abraham’s offspring blessing the nations (12:3 → Gal 3); Joseph’s rejected-then-exalted pattern; beginning of the messianic line.
spirit: The Spirit of God hovering over the waters (1:2); God who breathes life.
jesus_in_this_book: The promised Seed (3:15); Abraham’s offspring blessing the nations (12:3 → Gal 3); Joseph’s rejected-then-exalted pattern; beginning of the messianic line.
how_to_read: Trace the seed. Watch sin’s spread and grace’s counter-move.
watchman_charge: Guard the doctrine of creation and the image of God. Do not trade Genesis for a story that needs no Redeemer.
mbt_note: Primary voice NKJV; parallels as engine shows.
